2048.description: Slide, merge, reach the big one.
2048.author: Swirl
2048.tagline: Slide, merge, reach the big one.
2048.long: Slide the tiles around the board. Two tiles with the same number merge into one, double the value. Keep going until you reach 2048 - or run out of moves.\nArrow keys, WASD or a mouse swipe. R restarts. Your best score is saved.

blocks.author: Swirl
blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.long: The falling-block puzzle you know. Rotate and place the pieces to make full lines, which vanish and score points. Every ten lines the pieces fall faster.\nArrows to move and rotate, Space for a hard drop, P to pause.

breakout.author: Swirl
breakout.title: Breakout
breakout.long: Bounce the ball off your paddle and smash every brick. Where the ball hits the paddle changes its angle, so aim your shots. Clear the wall for a faster, trickier next level.\nMove with the mouse or A and D. Click or Space to launch.

cmatrix.description: Falling green code. Pure screensaver energy.
cmatrix.author: Swirl
cmatrix.title: Matrix
cmatrix.long: The falling-code rain, in its own window.\nC cycles colours (or press 1-6), + and - change the speed, Space pauses, R restarts. Resize the window to fill your screen.

coinflip.author: Leonid
coinflip.title: Coin Flip
coinflip.long: A simple virtual coin flipper. Great for making decisions.\nType: coinflip

cowsay.description: A talking cow for the terminal.
cowsay.author: Swirl
cowsay.title: Cowsay
cowsay.long:
The classic talking cow, now in the SwirlOS terminal.
Type: cowsay hello world
Or pick the penguin: cowsay -f tux I use SwirlOS btw
No message? The cow picks one for you.

doom.author: id Software
doom.title: DOOM
doom.long: The game that started it all. Fight through Knee-Deep in the Dead, the shareware episode, using SwirlOS's built-in DOOM engine.\nArrows to move, Ctrl to fire, Space to open doors, Esc for the menu.

doukutsu.description: Cave Story (Doukutsu Monogatari) - the freeware platformer by Studio Pixel.
doukutsu.author: Studio Pixel
doukutsu.title: Doukutsu
doukutsu.tagline: Cave Story, the legendary freeware platformer.
doukutsu.long: Wake up in a cave with no memory, meet the Mimigas, and take on the Doctor. Pixel-perfect run-and-gun exploration by Daisuke 'Pixel' Amaya, running on SwirlOS through SwirlRun.\nArrows to move, Z to jump, X to shoot, Q for the inventory. This package ships the English v1.2 freeware build; some later stages are not included yet.

snake.author: Swirl
snake.title: Snake
snake.long: A classic reborn for SwirlOS. Guide the snake to the berries, grow longer with every bite and steer clear of the walls and your own tail. The faster you eat, the faster it gets.\nArrow keys or WASD to steer, Space to pause. Your best score is saved.

swirl-c-ide.description: A small C editor with Check and Run buttons, built on the Tiny C Compiler.
swirl-c-ide.author: Swirl
swirl-c-ide.title: Swirl C IDE
swirl-c-ide.tagline: Write, build and run C without leaving the desktop.
swirl-c-ide.long: A focused code editor for C: line numbers, syntax colours, auto-indent, undo, find, and a real compiler one click away.\nCheck compiles and lists errors (click one to jump to the line), Run compiles in memory and runs your program with its output right under the editor. Ctrl+S save, Ctrl+B check, Ctrl+R run, Ctrl+F find, Ctrl+G go to line.\nNeeds the Tiny C Compiler package, which the Store installs for you.

swirl-upgrade.description: Bridge for older installs: adds a 'swirl-upgrade' terminal command that updates the whole system to the latest release.
swirl-upgrade.author: Swirl
swirl-upgrade.title: SwirlOS Upgrade (r61/r62)
swirl-upgrade.tagline: Update an old install in place - keeps your files.
swirl-upgrade.long: Installs from before r63 cannot update themselves: they have no system manifest and an older spm. This package brings the new spm and one terminal command, swirl-upgrade. It compares every system file by content, downloads only what changed, verifies each file and swaps them in safely (a failed update rolls back). Your files in /home/user and your settings are never touched.\nYou must boot a SwirlOS r63+ ISO first - the kernel lives on the boot medium and cannot be updated from inside the OS.

swirlspin.author: Swirl
swirlspin.title: Swirl Spin
swirlspin.long: The SwirlOS swirl as a solid 3D shape, rotating in its own window.\nDrag with the mouse to spin it, Space pauses, + and - change the speed, C cycles colours (violet, sunset, ocean, mono), R resets.

tcc.description: Tiny C Compiler: compile and run C programs on SwirlOS.
tcc.author: Fabrice Bellard & the TinyCC developers (SwirlOS port by Swirl)
tcc.title: Tiny C Compiler
tcc.tagline: A whole C compiler in 360 KB.
tcc.long: TinyCC 0.9.28rc ported to SwirlOS. Compile C in memory and run it straight away (tcc -run file.c), or build object files. Comes with the libc headers and <swirl.h> for talking to the kernel directly.\nUse it from the terminal, or install the Swirl C IDE for an editor with Build & Run.

welcome.description: Adds a 'welcome' terminal command with a short intro to spm.
welcome.author: qwerwasi6-lab
welcome.title: Welcome to spm
welcome.tagline: A friendly intro command for the terminal.

os.name: SwirlOS
os.notes: r80: new store app Swirl Spin (3D rotating SwirlOS logo). No kernel change.
